mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(latest_status = 'passed'), 0) AS passed, COALESCE(SUM(latest_status = 'failed'), 0) AS failed, COALESCE(SUM(latest_status = 'blocked'), 0) AS blocked, COALESCE(SUM(latest_status IS NULL), 0) AS untested FROM test_case WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id IN #{rid}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'running'), 0) AS running, COALESCE(SUM(status = 'done'), 0) AS done FROM test_plan WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id IN #{rid}
mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.req_id, r.name AS req_name, v.name AS version_name, p.status, p.planned_start, p.planned_end, p.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id) AS case_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result IS NOT NULL) AS executed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'passed') AS passed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'failed') AS failed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'blocked') AS blocked_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_plan_case pc WHERE pc.plan_id = p.id AND pc.result = 'skipped') AS skipped_count FROM test_plan p JOIN requirement r ON r.id = p.req_id LEFT JOIN project_version v ON v.id = p.version_id WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.req_id IN #{rid}
